description: UI affordances that visually distinguish a specific behavior, used stylistically across multiple components rather than owned by a single one.

values.label: Focus Ring
values.description: Visible ring or indicator drawn around a focused element for accessibility

values.label: Selection Indicator
values.description: Visual marker indicating which item among several is currently selected/active (e.g. tabs, carousels, steppers)

values.label: Drag Handle
values.description: A grip affordance for reordering an item via drag
